sources.evidence: Heidelberg Materials' official imprint identifies Heidelberg Materials AG as a German stock corporation registered with the Mannheim district court under HRB 330082.
Heidelberg Materials' 2025 annual financial statements list current Group mandates including Cimbenin SA, CimBurkina S.A., Austral Cimentos Sofala SA, Ciments du Togo SA and Scantogo Mines SA.
